description_en: Queries the cache analysis report of an instance on a specified date
description_zh: 查看实例在指定日期中的缓存分析报告
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-cache-analysis-report --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --date 2019-08-05Z --analysis-type BigKey --page-size 30 --page-numbers 1 --node-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000-db-0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCacheAnalysisReport

parameters.help_en: The date to query. You can query the report for one day each time. Specify the date in the *yyyy-MM-dd*Z format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的日期，每次可查询一天的离线全量Key分析结果，格式为yyyy-MM-ddZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: date

parameters.help_en: The type of analytics. Set the value to **BigKey**
parameters.name: analysis_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**.

> The default value is **30**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return.

> If the parameter value exceeds the maximum number of the returned pages, an empty large key list is returned
parameters.help_zh:
需要返回的页码。
> 如果该值大于返回结果的最大页数，则返回的大key结果为空
parameters.name: page_numbers

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the child node in the cluster instance.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the analysis results of all child nodes in the instance are returned
parameters.help_zh:
集群版实例的子节点ID。
> 集群版必填
parameters.name: node_id
